title: GNRA tetraloop
subtitle: A four-nucleotide hairpin sequence search followed by graph and official FR3D interaction and geometric validation.
definition: GNRA denotes a four-nucleotide hairpin loop in which G is the first base, N is any canonical base, R is A or G, and A is the fourth base. The characteristic fold contains a first-to-fourth G-A trans Sugar-Hoogsteen interaction.
query: Use the RNAdex type search for a hairpin with four unpaired nucleotides, filter the extracted sequence by G[ACGU][AG]A, and retain records with a generic non-WC edge between loop positions one and four.
boundary_note: RNAdex topology and sequence filters generate candidates, not motif assignments. The displayed representatives and fixed-seed audit sample were reannotated from atomic coordinates with FR3D and required to pass every interaction check and the literature-derived discrepancy cutoff. Only the displayed representatives are presented as high-confidence canonical examples; the broader candidate counts must not be interpreted as confirmed motif counts.

workflow_steps.label: Type search
workflow_steps.text: Select Hairpin and four unpaired nucleotides. RNAdex internally includes the closing pair in the stored row.

workflow_steps.label: Graph filter
workflow_steps.text: Require a generic non-WC edge between the first G and fourth A.

workflow_steps.label: Validate
workflow_steps.text: Atomic coordinates were reannotated with official FR3D Python. A local five-position reference in PDB 1JJ2 was used with the published FR3D stacking constraints and discrepancy cutoff; stricter cWW and tSH requirements were added for high-confidence canonical assignment.

confirmed_representatives.description: GAAA tetraloop in an NMR-refined tetraloop-receptor complex
GAAA tetraloop in the spinach chloroplast 30S subunit
GAGA tetraloop in the human nuclear pre-60S subunit

sources.title: Identification and characterization of new RNA tetraloop sequence families
sources.role: Operational four-nucleotide hairpin and GNRA definition.

sources.title: Exploring GNRA tetraloop-like motifs in nucleic acid 3D structures
FR3D: finding local and composite recurrent structural motifs in RNA 3D structures
sources.role: Official interaction annotation, geometric discrepancy, and published motif-specific cutoff.

validation.method: Atomic coordinates were reannotated with official FR3D Python. A local five-position reference in PDB 1JJ2 was used with the published FR3D stacking constraints and discrepancy cutoff; stricter cWW and tSH requirements were added for high-confidence canonical assignment.

reference.description: C(GAAA)G hairpin used as the local geometric reference; the published FR3D query used the corresponding motif in 1S72

acceptance_criteria: Strict closing cWW pair and first-to-fourth G-A tSH pair detected by FR3D. These canonical requirements are stricter than the published broad FR3D GNRA search, which allowed a bifurcated closing pair and omitted the tSH constraint.
Both stacking constraints from the published FR3D query detected.
Five-nucleotide FR3D discrepancy to the 1JJ2 GNRA is at most 0.8.

candidate_audit.sampling: Deterministic simple random sample, seed 20260729; curated representatives excluded.
